so_what: Ollie Gordon is the week's frenzy back: bwalsh89 (100 FAAB), pauldag (93) and StoneBone69 (75) list RB as a weak spot and ENOTS just lost Hall, and injury-replacement RBs have cleared 30 to 85 here before.
ENOTS is the most RB-desperate roster: 1-2, 10th of 10 on paper, Hall week-to-week and Achane already cut, so this is the week an RB offer lands best with a rare trader.
DiaperDutyDaddy lost Etienne and Coleman, Barkley faded after halftime, and at 57 FAAB he cannot outbid the 90-plus wallets; a trade is his realistic RB fix.
mfkr has Caleb Williams out 3-4 weeks and Jefferson day-to-day with WR already his worst slot; expect his 85 FAAB on Addison and a bridge QB, not on trades.
Keenum's clean Monday and Swift's 20 carries mean Chicago will lean on the run while Williams is out, so Sladsous loses less than Sunday suggested.
StoneBone69's Evans (ribs) and Coker (quad) are both day-to-day; short-term lineup pain for a 2-1 roster that is 2nd on paper, not a reason to sell.
Ekeler's return, White's shoulder and Croskey-Merritt's 1.9 a carry make Washington a three-way guess, so neither pauldag nor DadKing can sell his back as a weekly starter.
